answer_1.quote: We develop robust prompts for generative cluster labeling and frame assignment based on extensive empirical evaluation and best practices
answer_1.outputs: inductive summaries in table of contents style with frames as headings and cluster labels as subheadings

answer_2.quote: We selected the most effective prompt for each of the above models for cluster labeling. Our evaluation in Section 5 shows that GPT3.5 performs best in this task.

answer_4.quote: To manually evaluate the quality of the cluster labels, we used a ranking-based method in which four annotators scored the generated cluster labels against the manually annotated reference labels of each of the 300 clusters.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored the generated cluster labels against the manually annotated reference labels... To provide additional context for the cluster content, the five most semantically similar sentences to the reference label from each cluster were included, as well as five randomly selected sentences from the cluster.
